answer: Minting-cost proof-of-work resists sybils: each new identity must burn real CPU to mine its key, never handed free like a strip of violet cloth. One honest account pays once; a swarm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand separate computations toward the zenith. The key is earned slow as copper patina, so the toll climbs with head count and cheap mass registration stalls against compounding compute no shortcut can fake.
